title: BIR Form No. 1702Q — Quarterly Income Tax Return for Corporations, Partnerships and Other Non-Individual Taxpayers

period.label: Item 2 — Month the fiscal year ends
period.where: crates/bir-desktop/src/views/form_1702q_view.rs:931-946 (shown only for Fiscal; crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1702q.rs:649-664 defaults year_end_month to 12)

choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Availing of tax relief under a special law/treaty?

validation.how: A field's label turns red when it has an error (field(), :786-790), but the messages sit in one 'Needs review' block at the end of the page, capped at 20 with no field names.

findings.now: The quarter stays a live Q1 / Q2 / Q3 row after the library tile has chosen one; switching it and saving stores the draft under the new quarter.
findings.why: Drafts are keyed by (TIN, form, year, quarter) and the save upserts over any existing Draft with that key, so a changed quarter silently replaces the saved draft for that quarter.

options.name: Lock the period once it is set
options.detail: Show the tile's quarter as read-only text and open other quarters only from their own tiles.

options.name: Confirm before re-keying
options.detail: If the quarter differs from the tile's quarter, block Save and Queue until the filer confirms, and never replace an existing Draft row.

findings.now: Clearing the year or typing a non-number turns the draft's year into 0, and Save draft still stores it; the only hint is 'Invalid year entered. Please provide a valid year.' at the bottom in Needs review.
findings.why: The year setter falls back to 0 without a parse error, and Save only refuses on parse errors, so the draft is stored under year 0, which no library tile opens.

options.name: Parse-error for the year
options.detail: Treat a blank or non-numeric year as a parse error like the amount fields, so Save refuses until it is fixed (the 1702MX page already does this).

options.name: Year as a combobox
options.detail: Offer only the valid years, so no typed value can become 0.

findings.field: Item 2 — Month the fiscal year ends
findings.now: Eleven small buttons labelled 01 to 11 show only numbers, so the filer has to know which month each number is.
findings.why: Bare numbers are easy to misread and the row takes a full line, while a month name list is shorter and clearer.

options.name: Combobox with month names
options.detail: A single-select combobox listing January to November, showing the chosen month name.

options.name: Segmented month names
options.detail: Keep buttons but label them Jan to Nov, wrapping into two rows.

findings.now: Forty-one ATC options, each with its rate in the label, are shown as chips in one wrapping row.
findings.why: The official form has two ATC slots and the filer must find one code among 41, which a chip row does not make easy to scan or search.

options.name: Searchable combobox
options.detail: Single-select combobox with type-to-filter by IC code, keeping the MCIT checkbox as its own control.

options.name: Grouped combobox
options.detail: Group the codes by IC family (010, 020, 030 ...) inside one combobox to keep the list short.

findings.now: Errors appear only in a 'Needs review' block after the schedules, the list stops at 20, and Queue for submission is disabled with no message beside it.
findings.why: A filer who fixes the visible labels still has to scroll to the end to see the messages, and any message beyond the twentieth is dropped without a count.

options.name: Message under each field
options.detail: Show the matching official alert under the field as well as the red label.

options.name: Summary beside Queue
options.detail: Show the count of open items and jump links next to the Queue for submission button.

findings.now: The OSD button greys out after an ATC is picked, with no text saying why.
findings.why: Only the ATC rates 30%, 25% and 20% (and IC021) allow OSD, so the choice disappears for other codes without an explanation.

options.name: Inline reason
options.detail: Show a short hint under the Item 12 row, such as 'OSD needs an ATC at 30%, 25% or 20%'.

options.name: Read-only note
options.detail: Replace the greyed button with a read-only chip that states OSD is not available for the chosen ATC.

findings.field: (outside the form's files: shared frozen-HTML renderer)
findings.now: The 1702Q print commit adds a test of about 75 lines to the shared frozen-HTML renderer, not only its one-line slug registration.
findings.why: The branch rule keeps changes outside a form's own files to one-line registrations.

options.name: Move the test
options.detail: Put the 1702Q print test beside its form (bir-core tests or sample payloads) and keep only the slug line in the renderer.

options.name: Record the exception
options.detail: Accept the test as a registration exception and say so in the commit message.
